bullets.text: Designed SQL and Python ETL data pipelines that improved ingestion reliability, validation coverage, and downstream reporting readiness.
Built and maintained Airflow ETL workflows with scheduling, monitoring, and documentation to support trusted analytics and operational reporting.
Modeled data warehouse-ready datasets and collaborated with analysts to improve metric definitions, lineage, and stakeholder self-service.
Optimized Spark batch processing patterns for scalable data transformation using AWS cloud storage and distributed processing concepts.
